cohort: The study included neonates born before 37 weeks of gestation who were admitted to the neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) between April 2017 and December 2020.
finding: Extremely low gestational age (<28 weeks), a low 5-min Apgar score (<=3), and treatment with aminophylline, dobutamine, or morphine were significantly associated with an increased risk of Transient Hypothyroxinemia of Prematurity (THOP) in preterm infants.
